# P35.19 — Placement engine `placement@1` (export-time jurisdiction placement)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/299_P35.19__placement-engine.md`
(manifest row **299**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; JUR-02b / K4 §3.3–3.6
/ §4.4 / §5.3, ADR-092 compute-on-read — the export now *places* every
record against the verified boundary pack instead of trusting the declared
bucket alone). Invoked `live_verification=false` — committed code only;
**no export run, no republish, no production mutation** — the placement
output arrives with the next export/release under that row's own
authority. **Requirement ids stamped:** this row owns **F-04**, **F-135**,
**F-324**, **F-469**, **F-529** (the unresolved-bucket keying artefact,
located-elsewhere counts, jurisdiction-attribution coverage, the
point-in-polygon measure, the >25 km outside-polygon count); cited
context: **SIG-IDENT-004** (agency centroids never placed by location —
enforced as a hard guard), **SIG-IDENT-005/006** (scheme-qualified
canonical keys), **SIG-ONTO-010/011** (one boundary vintage per release),
**SIG-RECON-058** ("records"), **SIG-UI-048** (the unplaced set is
reported, never implied absent), **SIG-GEO-001**, **SIG-JUR-D03/D04/D05**
(K4 draft ids), **ADR-092**.
**Base:** `r11/P35.18-declared-jurisdiction-scheme` ·
**Gate:** none (D-K4-5's located-wins precedence is the recorded design
input, carried — never re-decided) · **Live legs:** none.

## What ships

- **`exports/placement.py` — the `placement@1` engine.** Construction is
  the fail-closed gate: `verify_pack` re-verifies the staged
  `sig.boundary-pack/1` directory, the bound `sig.jurisdiction-registry/1`
  must carry the same `boundaries_root` + the same per-source vintages, a
  spec-declared minting layer absent from the verified manifest refuses,
  and DuckDB `spatial` is strict `LOAD` — never a runtime `INSTALL`
  (K4 §4.4). `place_many` runs **one** batched point-in-polygon join
  (bbox-pruned, `ST_Covers` exact / `ST_DWithin` only for `non_us`-roled
  layers at the NE 0.02° coast tolerance) and then evaluates R1–R8
  per record in pure Python, first match wins.
- **The ruleset, verbatim.** R1 rejects `(0,0)` (`null_island`) and
  out-of-range/NaN (`invalid_point`); R2 walks the prefix-consistent
  chain country → admin-1 → county → place (a Census place is
  state-keyed — per-level evaluability is keyed by lineage, and the
  first missed level stops the chain); R3 detects axis swaps + sign
  flips into the declared boundary → `axis_swap_suspected` /
  `sign_flip_suspected`, the record falls back to the declared level and
  the point is **withheld**; R4 located wins over declared —
  `outside_declared` / `outside_declared_country`, both sides stay
  visible; R5 places declared-only when no usable point exists
  (`no_point` / `coordinates_conflicted`); R6 `outside_all_boundaries`;
  R7 `no_location_evidence`; R8 `name_unmatched` / `name_ambiguous` for
  non-site name lookups (fixture-only until I8 lands). Shared-boundary
  hits resolve to the lowest GEOID/code and report `on_boundary`; a
  deeper level never reached is `not_evaluated`, not unplaced. Landed
  P35.16 `geometry_defect` claims are consumed as inputs
  (`axis_swap`/`sign_flip` mark suspect, `null_island` rejects,
  `wrong_jurisdiction` leaves the point usable); an **unknown** defect
  class refuses the run — fail closed. A record with an
  `organization_centroid_or_unknown` precision stamp is never
  point-placed (SIG-IDENT-004).
- **The closed vocabulary is enforced, not just documented.** Every
  emitted `placement_check` is a member of `PLACEMENT_CHECKS` (the
  contract's 17-member list verbatim); `PlacementResult.__post_init__`
  refuses an off-vocabulary value — a ruleset bug fails the build.
- **The export seam** (`spine_export.py`): a new additive, gated
  `geometry_defects` read; `_slice_sites` batches every source's sites
  through the engine once and stamps the **seven additive columns**
  (`jurisdiction_key`, `jurisdiction_chain`, `placement_basis`,
  `placement_check`, `declared_scheme`, `declared_value`,
  `boundary_vintage`) — the legacy `jurisdiction` column is unchanged
  (the declared bucket, back-compat). A withheld point emits
  `geometry: null` on the sites row and never draws on the map
  (`lat/lon: null`, `locationAbsence: UNRESOLVED`, `placementCheck`
  names the verdict) — the raw observed pair stays on the claim rows;
  nothing is erased.
- **`web/placement.json` — `sig.placement-report/1`** (SIG-JUR-D05):
  the ruleset, the check vocabulary, pack provenance
  (`boundaries_root` + vintages), conservation-checked counts
  (`records == Σ by_check`, global + per-source), the
  located-vs-declared disclosure pairs, and the two-sided dossier view
  (`declared_here_located_elsewhere` / `located_here_declared_elsewhere`
  — the same disagreement counted on both sides). Emitted only when
  placement ran — absent input ⇒ absent artifact (honest absence).
- **`sig.published-record/3`** (`published_record.py`): the record's
  `jurisdiction` block gains `{jkey, chain[], basis, check, declared,
  boundary_vintage}` while `id` keeps the legacy declared bucket and
  `id_basis` preserves its provenance; a resolved-but-withheld point
  emits `location.kind: "point_withheld"` with the check as the reason —
  never the coordinate pair.
- **CLI + ops**: `--boundary-pack` / `--jurisdiction-registry` /
  `--boundary-spec` on `build --from-spine` — all-or-nothing (a
  half-staged input set refuses rc 2; a verification failure refuses
  rc 4 — the clock-guard refusal class). `ops/gcp/export.sh` adds the
  envs `SIG_EXPORT_BOUNDARY_PACK` / `SIG_EXPORT_JURISDICTION_REGISTRY` /
  `SIG_EXPORT_BOUNDARY_SPEC` — both unset ⇒ byte-identical args ⇒ no
  placement; `ops/Dockerfile` bakes `duckdb` `spatial` at image build.
- **No placement inputs ⇒ byte-identical output.** No engine bound ⇒ no
  columns, no `placement.json`, no map fields — pinned by test.
- **Nothing is written to the spine.** Placement reads the export's
  read-only snapshot and works in its own in-memory DuckDB — a test
  records every statement on the spine connection across a placement
  run: SELECT and transaction verbs only (ADR-092).

## Fixtures + verify

- `tests/exports/placement_fixtures.py` — `build_placement_env` builds a
  deterministic stand-in pack + registry through the real
  `build_pack`/`build_registry`/`verify_pack` path (labelled
  `capture_kind: stand-in`): the US chain US→US-CA→county 06037→place
  0644000 plus US-FL and the MO/KS shared border, NE-GB with the
  geonunit→GB-ENG rollup, NZ for the sign-flip matrix, and a
  `national:`-keyed layer for the MN/ID collision class.
- `tests/exports/test_placement.py` — **55 tests** over the full ticket
  matrix: R1 (null island + invalid, declared-fallback and unplaced
  forms), R2 chain consistency, R3 Nottingham axis-swap + GA/NZ
  sign-flip (declared fallback, point withheld), R4 CA→FL located-wins
  (+ `outside_declared`/`outside_declared_country`, ID/Indonesia and
  MN/Mongolia scheme collisions), R5/R6/R7, R8 name lookup,
  MO/KS tie-break → `on_boundary`, NE coast tolerance (and its bound —
  beyond 0.02° places nowhere), partial depth → `not_evaluated`, the
  SIG-IDENT-004 centroid guard, landed defect flags consumed (+ unknown
  class refuses), report conservation + the two-sided disclosure
  invariant, and the fail-closed input set (missing/tampered pack,
  `boundaries_root` divergence, vintage drift, registry schema
  mismatch, spec/pack layer drift, strict `LOAD` refusal).
- `tests/exports/test_spine_export.py` — **+10 integration tests**:
  the seven columns on emitted site rows, located-wins disclosed on
  row + report + dossier buckets, withheld-point suppression on sites
  + map, absent-engine byte-identical posture, `run_spine_export`
  end-to-end with the real `geometry_defects` read (and the
  no-spine-write assertion), half-staged input refusal, CLI flag
  validation.
- `tests/exports/test_published_record.py` — **+3**: the /3
  jurisdiction block, absent-block back-compat, `point_withheld`;
  the `/2`→`/3` schema expectation updated.
- `make check`: ruff/format/mypy clean (360 files); **pytest 9,217
  passed**. Honest caveats: four local-only/environmental failures
  none of which this change touches — `test_secrets` needs the
  `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` needle env (OP-07; green here with a placeholder),
  `test_p34_18_aliases` ×2 read the local-only gitignored restricted
  map and flag committed ancestor files (P34.39a records), and
  `test_release_publish_verify`'s deterministic-corpus pin re-pinned
  `p-ad9c…` → `p-7b7f…` for the /3 projection bump (the same re-pin
  P35.15a did for /1→/2 — the suite is now 30/30).
- `check_live_claims corpus`: **0 violations**. Docker suites
  (`tests/db`, `tests/e2e`) are unaffected — nothing in this change
  touches the spine schema or the composed stack.

## Boundaries

No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no HG gate tick, no merge/tag/`main`
push, no spine write (compute-on-read, verified by test), no live
fetch, no production pack in the repo (fixtures are honestly labelled
stand-ins), no ODbL compartment mixing (the placement report is SIG's
own analytical expression — CC-BY-4.0, web compartment). The PR range
keeps `4134d088` (the orchestrator restart/isolation record) as its
first commit.
